candidates.description: This vector is related to the Thai consonant letter "ท" (tho thahan) and its frequent appearance in various Thai words, syllables, and spelling contexts.
This vector is related to the Thai consonant 'ส' (so sua) and its various combinations with vowel marks and tone markers.
This vector activates for the Thai vowel sign sara ii combined with various consonant sounds.
This vector represents common Thai syllable endings, suffixes, and character sequences.
This vector represents Thai vowel marks and dependent vowel signs used in the Thai script.
This vector is related to subword tokens and characters commonly found in ancient Greek and multilingual text processing.
This feature vector activates on tokens and subwords related to the moons of Jupiter (such as Io, Dia, and Elara/Ananke) and spacecraft exploration missions (like New Horizons, Galileo, or Spirit).
This feature activates on the letter 'y' and its phonetic or graphical equivalents across various scripts and sub-word tokens.
This vector activates on common proper noun prefixes and linguistic suffixes across multiple writing systems.
This feature vector activates on a random collection of multilingual subwords and character fragments with no unifying semantic theme.
